.AVIATION...

Clear skies and light winds prevail through the evening period as 
high pressure maintains dry and stable conditions. Conditions will 
become favorable for some degree of fog and/or very low stratus 
development late tonight. Forecast will continue to highlight a 
window for MVFR to IFR visibility restrictions with an entry level 
mention for very low stratus. There remains potential for one or 
more southeast Michigan terminals to witness a period of LIFR in 
fog/stratus, although confidence in occurrence remains too low to 
include attm. Any lingering fog/stratus will lift thru late morning, 
affording another period of clear skies with light wind for the 
remainder of the daylight period.
